python3 << 'EOF'
# Let me verify the data extraction from the table

# Net options positions from the table (in millions of euros):
# 02/05/20: -444

# 04/01/20: -67
# 04/08/20: -125
# 04/15/20: -197

    ("02/05/20", -444),
    ("02/12/20", -549),
    ("02/19/20", -469),
    ("02/26/20", -461),
    ("03/04/20", -43)
]

# 5 weeks AFTER 03/11/20 (the pandemic declaration week)
after_weeks = [
    ("03/18/20", -24),
    ("03/25/20", -100),
    ("04/01/20", -67),
    ("04/08/20", -125),
    ("04/15/20", -197)
]

cumulative_before = sum(pos for _, pos in before_weeks)
cumulative_after = sum(pos for _, pos in after_weeks)

print("5 weeks BEFORE pandemic declaration (excluding 03/11/20):")
for date, pos in before_weeks:
    print(f"  {date}: {pos}")
print(f"  Cumulative: {cumulative_before}")

print("\n5 weeks AFTER pandemic declaration (excluding 03/11/20):")
for date, pos in after_weeks:
    print(f"  {date}: {pos}")
print(f"  Cumulative: {cumulative_after}")

difference = abs(cumulative_before - cumulative_after)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {difference} million euros")
EOF
